No network sources yet. Tap "Add source" to add a SMB, WebDAV or folder; after scanning they become playable in the library.

Delete "%1$s"?

This will also:
1. remove the locally stored connection info for this source;
2. remove this source's music file entries and their metadata from the library.

If the same music exists in multiple sources, only this source's entries are removed and others stay; an entry is removed together with its metadata only when this is its only source.

While syncing, background auto-sync and on-play lyric matching are paused, and network requests may be dense, possibly affecting playback. It is recommended to do this while idle and not playing.
On: background metadata sync keeps working and is unlikely to be killed by the system
Off: background sync may be killed by the system; authorization recommended
